notes.title: X-MiGu officially dissolves, thanks and take care!!!
notes.notes:
Today X-MiGuPLAY has officially initiated the process of dissolving the company as I move on to new ventures. I have learned a great deal running this experiment and I am in no way leaving the game industry, just ending this venture because other projects are requiring so much touch time and attention and I am at capacity. 

Thank you to everyone (even the jerks) that has provided feedback and supported the games. This has always been about product development and developing products catered for a specific segment. To date X-MiGu has sold $31,345 (5,894 units) and gained much experience and knowledge about accommodating audiences and developing games. 

At the end of the day, this venture began from a passion of gaming and a desire to learn about publishing and developing. If you are sitting there wishing you could learn how to do this—I encourage you to at least try—there is a lot of joy and fulfillment in doing the work.   

The games are staying active in perpetuity A) because people are still purchasing, and B) cause why not? I am always interested in hearing feedback and can be reached at xmiguplay@gmail.com. I don't check that inbox frequently, but I do from time to time and will do my best to respond to folks. 

In a world where you can be anything, be kind. If you are struggling with any form of adversity in your life, I hope you seek help or can find actions to change or improve your situation. We are one species and one planet and the best way we can celebrate our humanity is by being good to one another. Thank you again to everyone that I connected with or that tried any of the games I published. 

Cowabunga dudes & dudettes!

notes.title: BBB Visual Novel Release delayed ... again. Yup. Again.
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Just updating everyone as X-MiGuPLAY will be delaying this release. Again. 

The script has been done more or less since (scratches chin, sips some coffee) April 2019ish? One of the draw backs of producing games alone is... when delays happen, it can be like a horse kick in the nuts. But I'm not angry. I love making these games and the delays have been driven by positive things like adding content & getting Anya's voice actress to do an F ton of voices to bring this novel to life. 

So what has happened and where are we at?

1. NSFW Adults ONLY is official. The boobs are on the loose. The final decision has been made to keep this visual novel in its original form and not hold back the content that pushes the game into Adults Only land.

2. With the NSFW state locked in, I added bonus content that is appropriately inappropriate. This game will ship with bonus lapdance content similar to Anya's X-Mas Special. Plus we are including some palette modded BBB Power Claw brawling action too.

3. Voice acting. The decision to add voice acting has contributed greatly to the delays. The novel is approx 22,000 words long and we sat down and recorded every word. Voice recordings wrapped last week. Mixes were done this week and currently the sounds bites are being chopped up and exported for game engine import. 

4. Music. I wrote and arranged new music. That too is time consuming.

I think those are all the talking points I got. Hope to release before August and hope people enjoy it when it is done! Hope everyone out there is staying healthy and safe during these crazy times. Cheers.

-M

notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY NEWS & Site update!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam land!

NEWS!

[b]1. X-MiGuPLAY  has updated xmiguplay.com[/b] for 2020. Upcoming games have been added to the site and we tried to pull the site out of the 90s and give it a more modern feel! As always opinions are welcomed!

[b]2. X-MiGuPLAY's Business standing[/b]: How to deliver this without it coming across the [i]wrong way?[/i]

Let me try. So ... we are profitable! Now, we haven't  sold a million copies or anything crazy but, I wanted to announce this. I was doing some marketing research and learned that most indie devs fail in regard to recovering initial investments. 

I am happy to say we have covered our initial investment and while we maintain a small  revolving debt for investments, as any company would, we were stoked to see that we hit this milestone.   

From the outside looking in, it may seem that our traffic is pretty dismal but, as we discovered in our traffic breakdowns, we learned that we've actually ranked on Best Sellers on several occasions. So, long story short, [b]THANK YOU to all that have supported this venture ... 

This truly is a labor of love and we are committed to bringing more content and improving along the way![/b]

[b]3. Bare Boob Brawlerz's's'ss Visual Novel[/b] will come out ... but when it is ready! The delays on this title have been driven by adding more & more illustrative work, which is pretty time consuming. Almost all frames involve scene pre-renders with 3D models and then digitally drawn Manga inspired adaptations. In addition to that, we are scheduling time for voicing the entire thing. Novel is currently pushing 22,000 words and we've surpassed 200 illustrations thus far.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

[b]4. Dr. DONG is coming [/b]: its in pre-production now, core plot scripting, character designs and environmental plotting is pretty much what we are working on now. I hope the game comes out this year but, that could be pretty unrealistic sooooo ... we shall see. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217950/Dr_Dick_Dong_Stripper_Underworld/


That's all I got to blab about. So, thank you and have a dope a$$ weekend!

Regards, 
-M

notes.title: X-MiGu NEWz - new games coming!
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

Bare Boob Brawlerz is nearing its double release for Q4 2019. 

There will be the action game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892160/BARE_BOOB_BRAWLERZ_POWER_CLAW/

and the visual novel:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906560/Bare_Boob_Brawlerz_Novel_01_Visual_Novel/

Currently, I am expecting to release Power Claw in October and the Visual novel in November/December.

[u][b]THE ACTION GAME:[/b][/u]
The action game is "BARE BOOB BRAWLERZ: POWER CLAW"! This game is launching as a 1 player game. With our success and inundation of quality feedback, this game is very much molded by user feedback colliding with X-MiGu styled entertainment. 

1. Human nudity. While some of our users loved the weirdness of a lavender gray alien being topless in a fighting game, some of our user were like yo, dude ... can we just have women? Like, human women? And I was like yeah brah! While future Stripper Anya titles will continue to explore alien sexuality, the Bare Boob Brawlerz universe is 100% human characters.

2. Game modes. Being a side scrolling and retro fighting game nerd, I know one of the challenges for developers to over come is the monotony of side scrolling games. After your 250th purple and black foot soldier, fighting an evil army can feel a lot like that dish washer job I had in early college. To combat that, I have built BBB Power Claw to feature both a side scrolling fighting game mode and a 1 on 1 fighting game mode. This along with a slew of unique looking enemies with a variety of attack strategies, a robot vacuum cleaner and some environmental damage should help keep the gaming experience fresh. At the same time, I always envisioned my games being played while people were downloading updates for their AAA games that are dozens of Gigs. Also, if you don't have good quality toilet paper, wipe with your left, shake with your right. 

3. Performance: The code, game mechanics and structure of this game are figgity-fresh. That said, new strategy was implemented  on compacting graphical assets and organizing asset usage to maximize use of the 1080 output of the game while ... minimizing memory requirements and increasing animation frames for more bouncing bo.... dont give me that look, you knew what this was! :P

[u][b]The Visual novel![/b][/u]

Bare Boob Brawlerz: Novel 01 (Visual Novel) is in-fact directly related to the action game. In early development, the effort to tell a quality story that could be a giant excuse for a developer to make games with nipples in every fruggin frame transformed into a pretty big story. Though the final length of the story is still being edited and tweaked, the length 'in word' should be inline with what you could expect from a physical novel. Like what ancient man would buy from a store ( I shop mostly online, gives me more time to make games). 

From our forums, I wrote words n' stuff about the game and whatevz...

Bare Boob Brawlerz: Visual Novel follows the story of Vestal who exists in a futuristic version of our planet! Humans hid for countless years underground as beaten and polluted Earth was given centuries to clean its atmosphere without human intervention.

Fast forward to the 'Day of Emergence' and the once noble leaders that executed the brilliant move underground to save humanity have been washed away by political manipulation and evil entities. En-Ti-Tiddies? Anyway...

On a new Earth, smaller outlaw and rebellious groups become the foundation for the onset of the movement to overthrow said ... dun-dun-duuuun ... the bad government people!

About the development:
This Visual Novel has been in development for sometime. The intent is to tell a story that is in-depth and offers complexity. X-MiGu styled entertainment and a healthy dose of originality and of course ... tiddies, blood, and genital mutilation! The artistic intent regarding my approach on how I've drawn the anime styled illustrations is what I would describe as a dark graphic novel look and feel.


[u][b]Other Words[/b][/u]
I donated to the Rainforest Alliance for X-MiGu's annual contribution to the world slash sorry I make tiddie titles fund.
https://www.facebook.com/RainforestAlliance/

I also plan on making a donation to the folks of the Bahamas.

Since X-MiGu launched in 2017, our audience has continued to grow! I put a lot of effort in what is created and published. So, thank you to all that have supported me ... er X-MiGu-me? Anya?  

I am happy to see wishlist and sales growth with every passing month. You can always email at info@xmiguplay.com with feedback or memes. I like EDM and Death Metal too, so feel free to send me any new cool music you have discovered. Oh yeah, if you are not familiar with my first two titles:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/671630/STRIPPER_ANYA_DEMON_SLAYER/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/705700/Stripper_Anya_2_XMiGuFighters/

Cheers!

-M

Stripper Anya's update has gone live!

Why VST? It is an abbreviation for Version 2.0 or  'VerSion Two point o' if you're nasty...  

Here is an uncensored clip of game play:
https://youtu.be/9HIly76nunU

... so wutz tha deal?

For starters, this game still includes the original version of Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer from 2017. I did patch a couple things and some audio changes have been made as all the music and cut scenes were remixed.  A lot of what was changed is driven by our user feedback in regard to both versions and some changes were ... well ... driven by me. You can still play the original version of Anya in the game, you must select the 'legacy' version as it is now officially called.

VST. v2.0 features mucho newcho. One of my favorite editions are the Manga illustrations. Artist Luna Hyena hailing from Japan was hired last year to draw the characters based on the 3d models from the game including ... redesigned Anya. I grew up watching Manga Movies and have always loved this art form and I am so STOKED to have some authentic manga bring Anya's story to life.

Oh yeah ... Anya was completely redesigned from head to toe, she's rocking some bow action. She also comes with a bunch of new moves, all freshly animated, and has some new weapons including a completely redesigned sword, chainsaw and stone ____.

[IMG]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/937214613627554208/F7C0D3685E4ECFB5FBE4D9C2BB10EA44EC7887C3/[/IMG]

notes.title: X-MiGuPLAY donates to Breast Cancer Foundation
notes.notes:
Hello all! 

With a successful first month since launch coming to a close, X-MiGuPLAY is happy to announce that we donated to a Breast Cancer Foundation of behalf of Stripper Anya: Demon Slayer.

The donation made today was paid for in advance by X-MiGuPLAY's owner. The amount roughly approximates to $0.52 per copy sold!

X-MiGuPLAY is committing to donate a portion of our sales at minimum once a year. If sales continue at this pace we hope to donate again around December! 

** We had a link provided here to said foundation. Unfortunately, due to PR complications, the company has asked that we remove their name from any public mentions of donations. We will continue to donate regardless of this speed bump. Hopefully we can find a company that we can publicly endorse in the future. The donations until further notice will be made privately by X-MiGuPLAY's owner. **

A deep and sincere thank you to our international audience! 


Regards,
-M
